Annotations

Nabu supports normal, marker, and single-element annotations, arrays, nested annotations, and default values.

@Deprecated(since = "1.5")
public class SomeClass {

    @Deprecated
    @Override
    fun clear(): void {
    }
}

Annotation retention and target are emitted via AsmByteCodeEmitter.emitAnnotations.

Annotation interfaces themselves can also be declared in Nabu. The compiler also has deep support for running JSR-269-style annotation processors — see Annotation Processing.
